master_basedir.description: Base directory for the Buildbot master instance.

botmaster_maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries per build step before failing.

slave_port.description: TCP port on which Buildbot listens for buildslave connections.

db_url.description: Database connection string (e.g., sqlite:///state.sqlite or postgresql+postgresql://user:pass@host/db). When provided, legacy db_* fields are ignored.

db_port.description: Legacy PostgreSQL port (ignored if db_url is set).

protocols.description: List of protocols for Buildbot master communication (e.g., pb, wamp). Each item specifies the protocol name and connection options.

log_level.description: Global logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, or CRITICAL.

user_root.description: Root directory for user-specific data (if used).

user_storage_class.description: Class for user storage backend (e.g., 'util.MemoryUserDB'). Empty disables user storage.

force_builds.description: Whether to allow force builds via web UI and API.

build_horizon.description: Maximum number of builds to retain in memory (0 = unlimited).

event_horizon.description: Maximum number of events to retain for event distribution (e.g., to web UI).

status_targets.description: List of status targets (e.g., web UI, mail, IRC). Each defines a status service class and constructor arguments.

builders.description: List of builders defining CI/CD pipelines.

schedulers.description: List of schedulers for triggering builds on new changes.

change_sources.description: List of change sources (e.g., Git, GitHub, Mercurial).

force_build_user.description: Username required to force builds via web UI (if auth is enabled).
